Bug-fix release.

- **"Also build for" now retargets every binary.** Executables with the PS5-style SELF header
  (most dumps) kept the main target's SDK in the extra `-fwN` builds; only `param.json` changed.
  The extra builds now also refuse to finish if any binary still declares the main target.
  *Reported on GBAtemp, thanks!*
- **"Open folder" works in the Linux app.** The file manager was started with the app's bundled Qt
  libraries and quit immediately.
